headline: November Patch Tuesday fixes flaws but triggers install, SQL and activation bugs
summary: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday update fixed Windows security flaws and an earlier USB audio issue, but caused new problems: failed installations on some systems, SQL Server performance issues, Windows activation failures, and printing problems. Microsoft confirmed several issues and later shipped emergency out-of-band fixes for the activation failures.
